Usage: gb COMMAND [OPTIONS]

Commands:
  rom info|verify|diff|patch    Inspect, compare, validate, and patch cartridges
  asm compile|decompile       Assemble source or inspect/export ROM bytes
  project init|import|resolve  Create, import, and resolve source projects
  build                       Build an editable project or source file
  run                         Execute a cartridge in the bundled emulator
  test                        Check a cartridge against assertions
  debug                       Run a deterministic debugger script
  mcp serve                   Expose local utilities to an AI agent over stdio
  capabilities                Discover machine-readable contracts
  schema                      Retrieve versioned JSON Schemas
  version                     Print the toolkit version

Use gb COMMAND --help for details.
Legacy flat init/import/inspect/verify/disassemble/patch aliases remain supported.

All utility commands accept --json. Numbers accept decimal or 0x hexadecimal.
Writes refuse existing outputs unless --overwrite is supported and supplied.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 operation failed, 2 usage error, 3 validation/assertion failed.

Authoring: game validate, game export, rom patch-create, asm symbols, asset convert/encode/decode.
Projects: project test, project status; build --receipt FILE records dependencies and tool hashes.

Optional --receipt FILE records effective build options, input/output hashes and resolved tool identities. Manifests support ordered sources, includeDirectories, defines, assets, tests and receipt. Assets are generated in staging before assembly; all artifacts commit together.

Print a bounded candidate instruction listing (default offset 0x100, 64 instructions).
--output without range options writes full byte-exact RGBDS data source; a range writes a diagnostic listing.
Original symbols, high-level source, and code/data boundaries cannot be recovered.

run:
run ROM [--frames N] [--memory ADDRESS:LENGTH,...] [--assert FILE.json]
        [--buttons A,start] [--breakpoint ADDRESS] [--max-instructions N]
Run the bundled emulator with bounded ticks (default 60 frame budgets, max 3600).
Assertion file: {"memory":[{"address":49152,"bytes":[1]}],"registers":{"pc":336}}.
Breakpoint addresses are mapped CPU addresses, across all current ROM banks.
Exit 3 for failed assertions or an unreached requested breakpoint.

Optional --screenshot FILE writes final RGBA PNG even when an assertion fails. --overwrite allows replacing capture outputs. --symbols FILE.sym resolves string memory addresses and PC assertions; only bank-0 ROM0, WRAM0 and HRAM labels are accepted. Use gb schema assertions --json for the assertion file contract. Exit 3 on failure.

debug:
debug ROM --script FILE.json
Execute step, frame, read, write, breakpoints, run, and assert operations in order.
Bus writes affect runtime RAM/IO/mapper state. Cartridge files are preserved.
Script: {"version":1,"commands":[{"op":"step","count":1},{"op":"read","address":49152,"length":16}]}
Use gb schema debug --json for the full contract.

All utility commands accept --json. Numbers accept decimal or 0x hexadecimal.
Writes refuse existing outputs unless --overwrite is supported and supplied.
Exit codes: 0 success, 1 operation failed, 2 usage error, 3 validation/assertion failed.

Optional --screenshot FILE writes final RGBA PNG even when an assertion fails. --overwrite allows replacing capture outputs. --symbols FILE.sym resolves string memory addresses and PC assertions; only bank-0 ROM0, WRAM0 and HRAM labels are accepted. Numeric addresses retain mapped current-bank semantics.

Script operations also include buttons (pressed array replaces held state), until (bounded memory/register conditions), and capture (unique safe name). Assertions accept framebufferSha256. --capture-dir DIRECTORY saves named captures and failed visual assertions as PNG. See gb schema debug --json for aggregate budgets.

rom patch-create:
Usage: gb rom patch-create BEFORE AFTER --output PATCHES.json [--overwrite] [--json]

Create expected-byte-guarded patches from equal-length ROMs. Unchanged bytes inside bounded ranges may also be guarded. Apply with gb rom patch; neither input is modified.
asm symbols:
Usage: gb asm symbols SYMBOLS.sym [--symbol NAME] [--json]

List RGBDS labels with bank, CPU address and physical ROM offset, plus exported constants. Names are case sensitive. Constants and RAM labels have no physical ROM offset.
game:
Usage: gb game COMMAND

validate GAME.json: validate implemented collection-game mechanics without writing.
export GAME.json DIRECTORY [--name NAME]: preserve the spec and export editable RGBDS source into a new workspace.
game validate:
Usage: gb game validate GAME.json [--json]

Validate the GameSpec without allocating an emulator or writing files. Discover fields with gb schema game --json.
game export:
Usage: gb game export GAME.json DIRECTORY [--name NAME] [--json]

Create a separate source workspace containing the original spec and matching RGBDS assembly. Edit the exported assembly to add mechanics; future builds use source, not changes to the saved spec.
asset:
Usage: gb asset COMMAND

convert PNG --output TILES.2bpp [--tilemap FILE] [--palette FILE] [--attrmap FILE]: convert with rgbgfx.
encode PIXELS.json --output TILES.2bpp: encode numeric palette indices.
decode TILES.2bpp --output PIXELS.json: decode to numeric palette indices.
All outputs preserve inputs and require --overwrite to replace existing files.
asset convert:
Usage: gb asset convert IMAGE.png --output TILES.2bpp [--tilemap FILE] [--palette FILE] [--attrmap FILE] [--overwrite] [--json]

Convert PNG via rgbgfx (RGBDS_BIN or PATH). Dimensions must be multiples of 8, up to 4096 tiles. Palette output is CGB RGB15; attribute output is CGB-oriented. All requested outputs commit together.
asset encode:
Usage: gb asset encode PIXELS.json --output TILES.2bpp [--overwrite] [--json]

Encode a numeric JSON array of palette indices 0-3. Pixels are ordered by tile, then row and column. Supply 1-4096 complete 8x8 tiles. No external tool is required.
asset decode:
Usage: gb asset decode TILES.2bpp --output PIXELS.json [--overwrite] [--json]

Decode 1-4096 complete planar 16-byte tiles into a numeric JSON pixel array in tile, row, column order. No external tool is required.
project status:
Usage: gb project status [PROJECT] [--receipt FILE] [--json]

Compare receipt input, output and executable hashes to disk without running tools or writing. Defaults to the manifest receipt path. Returns exit 3 when missing or stale.
project test:
Usage: gb project test [PROJECT] [--suite FILE] [--build] [--overwrite] [--symbols FILE.sym] [--report FILE] [--capture-dir DIRECTORY] [--json]

Run version-1 named cases in fresh emulator sessions. Defaults to manifest tests or tests.json. --build builds once after validating every case and aggregate budgets. Independent cases continue after assertion failures; failure returns exit 3. Reports and PNG captures commit as one batch. See gb schema suite --json.
